meaning: Grouped authoring requirements; no slice acceptance or new runtime syntax. Complete source rules stay in candidates and source pages.

groups.requirement: Represent five-mile stages, pace and terrain ceilings, good roads, slow travelers, special movement and mount fast-travel budgets; use the complete pace/rate/check tables. Bind marching order, encounter distance, navigation, foraging and search to each stage. Advance actual elapsed time once, settling timed sources and supplies, then legal arrival and events.
groups.blocker: Current hex movement costs and End Turn day advancement are not the SRD distance/pace clock. Terrain aliases plains/grassland, town/urban and dungeon/Underdark require campaign mapping. Foraging yields, lost-route outcomes and weather forecasts require authored facts, not invented SRD quantities.

groups.requirement: Use actual source space, plane, vicinity, senses and observer. Retain hidden-object, trap, Medicine, Insight, tracks and Study declarations independently; automatic language recognition is distinct from rolling to notice. Reveal only the declared result to eligible observers and persist receipts without another roll or cost.
groups.blocker: OA-01–OA-13 room controls are reusable bounded hosts. Generated event checks have no positioned trap or automatic general Search/disarm implementation. Do not convert flavor text into hidden-object/track/knowledge facts.

groups.requirement: Own each actual lock and trap: closed/open, ordinary locked/barred/jammed, exact matching key/tool copy, key authorization, check and break routes. Separate trap discovery, trigger, disarm, consequence and reset/inert state. Arcane Lock authorizations/password and Knock one-lock selection/suppression/noise must preserve their full existing spell rules.
groups.blocker: Crown trapped_chest is a custom INT13 event that combines discovery/disarm and has branch-specific rewards. It is not the SRD Poisoned Needle or Poisoned Darts example. No trap geometry, detection/disarm split, reset rule or event-duration conversion is authored in that seed; hold those decisions. Do not replace the custom outcomes with an SRD example or infer key destruction/consumption.

groups.requirement: Address actual objects and exact carried/ground/container copies, including collocated targets. Preserve material, size, mass/volume, fixed/attached state, HP/AC, thresholds, immunities, magical/worn/carried eligibility and exact contents. Manipulation, damage, destruction, repair and cleaning must change the selected copy; repair preserves identity and respects pieces, break dimensions and exclusions.
groups.blocker: Use existing room/object and item-copy hosts; metadata is not proof every attack/spell/tool route executes. Unknown weight, volume, metal, magic or repair facts remain unknown. Mending is not resurrection, general HP refill or replacement loot.

groups.requirement: Track actual food pounds, water gallons, capacity, contamination, intake, size-based daily requirements, expiry/spoilage and remaining stock. Consume exact copies/quantities once; magical nourishment and no-eating/drinking exceptions keep their specific scope. Apply the full dehydration/malnutrition Exhaustion and recovery restrictions at actual deadlines.
groups.blocker: Food servings and magical spring potion flavor do not establish pounds/gallons or infinite refill. Production survival size lookup and each projected form/created actor need reconciliation with actual effective size and exception sources. Keep legacy nourishment deadlines distinct from physical intake.

groups.requirement: Bind heat, burning, falling, breathing/suffocation and selected environmental exposure to actual positions, altitude, surfaces, time and defenses. Distinguish an effect appearing from creature movement, entry, start/end turns and elapsed ticks. Water Walk grants traversal without heat immunity; source-specific descent/landing and breathing exceptions remain attached.
groups.blocker: Ashvale heat is campaign-authored 1d4 at five feet, not generic SRD lava damage. Storm/rockslide/cave-in events remain custom checks, not a whole weather or avalanche simulation. No general weather, underwater route, air volume or climate can be inferred from terrain names.

groups.requirement: Query actual observer/source positions, light, occlusion, range, hearing/noise, planes and borrowed senses. Own light emitters/fuel and magical darkness sources; perception and detection expose only eligible facts. Remote sensors retain their specific origin, control cost, movement, sense choice and limits.
groups.blocker: Map reveal is not sight, detection, object discovery or knowledge. Existing senses and room noise hosts do not supply all remote-sensor/spell consumers; do not invent ambient light or weather from a dungeon description.

groups.requirement: Persist exact cast/object/area source, geometry, origin, plane, selected recipients/exemptions, authorization, stored spell/slot level, trigger ledger and independent expiry. Resolve appearance, moving-area membership, creature crossing, start/end and delayed aftermath under their own rules. Glyph releases its stored eligible spell once and retains movement/dispel endings.
groups.blocker: Existing areas, Alarm and located aftermath are reuse points. Geometry selection or a logged alarm is not every spell effect. Full stored-spell, sensor, permanent ward and dispel-level consumers still require cross-set mapping; no per-spell ID handler.

groups.requirement: Author factual text/knowledge and actual languages, literacy, attitude, senses, communication route and recipient identity. Preserve Druidic and Thieves’ Cant distinctions, secret-message notice versus deciphering, corpse/plant/animal knowledge limits, question counts, time windows and divination uncertainty/history. Illusion discovery and social consequences are per observer; use bounded authored outcomes where world judgment is required.
groups.blocker: Ghost warnings, rumors, journals, maps, prophecy, corpses and plants need actual authored answers before an information spell can query them. Fallen guard has no former knowledge. Flavor does not grant full NPC stats, an encounter, a quest, or omniscient answers. ADR-0023 still owns Wish/illusion policy.

groups.requirement: Reuse creature selectors and actor candidates. Bind exact remains/body identity, creature type/size, age of death, preservation, knowledge, gear, consumed/reanimated state and ownership. Carry created actors, commands, control/appearance lifetimes, death, legal arrivals and temporary equipment through room/combat transitions without respawning or paying loot.
groups.blocker: Campaign guard bones and event traveler prose lack some life/death/knowledge facts. Do not infer a valid Revivify target or fabricate corpse answers. Created undead equipment, temporary steed tack and campaign finale Rejuvenation policy retain creature-pass blockers.

groups.requirement: Use represented legal footprints, ceilings, wall heights, terrain, planes, anchoring, containment capacity, passengers/cargo and actual traveled routes. Retain source-specific movement, flight loss, squeeze/gas/stone access, safe return and blocked expulsion without overlap or telefrag. Door/container contents and unauthorized crossing remain exact identities.
groups.blocker: Existing room placement, containment and vessel hosts are bounded; broad travel/waterborne/plane routes and every spell-specific access rule still need consumers. Fairy ring prose does not define a second map or implement return to origin.

groups.requirement: Coordinate campaign seconds, cast/work durations, Short/Long Rest lifecycle, interruption, daily limits, resource/Hit Dice recovery and exactly owned expiry. Preserve exceptions such as Trance, Aspect of the Moon and spell rest-like benefits without manufacturing a completed rest or resetting a separate resource.
groups.blocker: Event rest currently calls reset_rest_features; that is not proof of eight-hour Long Rest or the full shared rest lifecycle. Inn healing/rest/blessing order is retained pending explicit campaign-event mapping. Numeric event turns are not automatically seconds or combat rounds.

groups.requirement: Track campaign conjunction of three actual Crown fragments and defeated lich_king, four once-only milestone triggers, dungeon clear and generated room claims. Bind reward settlement to the actual occurrence, victory, recipient and allowed checkpoint. Distinguish a repeatable random table roll from reopening the same event occurrence; never mint a second object/currency grant on resume.
groups.blocker: Monster loot metadata does not prove payment. Quest-board reward metadata has no EventDialog consumer; no post-combat bounty settlement found. claim_reward exists but its call sites outside its declaration are harness checks, not actual payouts. Dungeon clear uses cleared_dungeons and a separate payout route. Inventory-full/lost grant, child-event continuation and normal creation-to-finale proof remain unverified.
